source.title: Know Your Weapon, Parts 1–2
source.author: Espen Gaarder Haug
source.note: Pairs of slides are repeated in the supplied PDF. Private source retained locally; no PDF or slide captures distributed.

data_status: All numerical examples and charts are hypothetical, computed from explicit generalized BSM inputs; no empirical market data.
conventions: Raw volatility derivatives use decimal sigma; vega per vol point divides by 100; vomma per vol-point squared divides by 10000.
Time Greeks use elapsed calendar time: theta=-V_T, charm=-delta_T, color=-gamma_T, veta=-vega_T; daily sensitivities divide by 365.
Rho fixed b equals -T V; fixed yield means db/dr=1.
Ordinary unadjusted spot delta inversion, not forward or premium-adjusted delta.
All smooth Greeks require S,K,sigma,T strictly positive.
Partial derivatives hold other pricing inputs fixed; smile dynamics need separately specified total derivatives.

corrections.issue: Call strike-from-delta is missing minus sign before inverse normal.
corrections.resolution: Use exp((b+sigma²/2)T - sigma sqrt(T) invN(delta/A)); verify by round-trip.

corrections.issue: Remaining-time label and calendar-time signs mixed.
corrections.resolution: Declare calendar-time conventions and verify using decreasing remaining maturity.

corrections.issue: Saddle Gamma needs generalized r/b dependence.
corrections.resolution: T*=1/[2(2b-r+sigma²)] if denominator positive; stationary point is not global maximum.

corrections.issue: Speed stencil labeled central is shifted relative to S.
corrections.resolution: Use symmetric points S±h and S±2h with denominator 2h³.

corrections.issue: Global vega maximum needs domain conditions.
corrections.resolution: T=1/(2r) requires r>0 and optimizing both S and T at fixed K.

corrections.issue: VegaP and Vega leverage prose mix absolute and relative vol units.
corrections.resolution: Explicit shock sizes: .01 raw-vega per vol point; .01 sigma raw-vega per 1% relative vol.

corrections.issue: Missing sigma in Call theta first term and driftless theta; Put labels repeat Call.
corrections.resolution: Re-derive theta and check price finite difference.
Show both fixed b and fixed yield.

corrections.issue: Put strike-from-probability uses inverse normal of a negative probability.
corrections.resolution: Use positive p in invN(p) with positive sign in exponent.

corrections.issue: C_KK labeled risk-neutral density omits reversal of discount.
corrections.resolution: f_Q=exp(rT) C_KK; C_KK is discounted state-price density.

corrections.issue: Ever-ITM formula contains discounting and corresponds to cash-at-hit.

references.title: RiskFlow, FX and Equity valuation / One Touch

visual.notes: Deterministic calculated SVG and React charts. No generated artwork or third-party visual assets.

limitations: European generalized BSM only; no American exercise, jump simulation, transaction costs or smile calibration.
Greek approximations are local and do not guarantee realized P&L or successful hedging.
Historical market screenshots in the PDF are not reused.
